title: Content Atom
description: A thin content atom: stable identity + the invariant meaning payload + keyed bindings (references) into the sub-models. Renderings (translations, visual treatment, adaptive variants) are NOT stored here; they live in external stores keyed by atom_id. One agent owns each binding (single-writer).

atom_id.description: Stable, opaque, durable identity. The single join key across the object graph, every locale pack, the registries, and the learner model. Never reused, never edited.

content_hash.description: Hash of the meaning payload. Lets the system detect when meaning actually changed (invalidating downstream renderings) versus when only structure moved. Used to preserve identity across re-export.

meaning.description: The invariant truth the atom owns. The ONLY embedded payload. Everything else is a reference.

source_locale.description: BCP-47 tag of the canonical source language.

source_text.description: The canonical source-language string. Audience-agnostic. Translations live in locale packs keyed by atom_id — not here.

kind.description: Semantic kind of the meaning (NOT its visual type — that is an expression key).

bindings.description: Keyed references into the sub-models. Extensible: new facet types may be added as agents need them. Each binding is owned (written) by exactly one agent; others read only.

object.description: Structure. Owner: Content Architecture. The atom's place in the object graph — carried as references to other atom_ids.

prerequisites.description: atom_ids that must precede this one.

intent.description: Meaning/purpose. Owner: L&D / Instructional Design. References into the intent ontology — the atom points into it, it does not contain it.

teaches.description: objective_ids in the intent ontology this atom serves.

intended_response.description: The cognitive/affective response the atom is designed to elicit.

expression.description: Form. Owner: Brand + Localization. KEYS into the expression registries (visual, glossary, motion) — never the rendered styles or translations themselves.

content_type.description: Key into the visual registry → motion/typography/brand tokens.

term_refs.description: Glossary-registry term_ids present in this atom (locked terminology).

audience.description: Fit hooks. Owner: L&D Adaptivity. Design-time targeting + adaptivity metadata the responsive engine matches against the live learner model. Holds NO learner PII or runtime state — that lives in the separate learner model.

segment_scope.description: Design-time audience segments / RBT tiers this atom targets.

difficulty.description: Relative difficulty, for matching to learner mastery.

variant_group.description: Group id of interchangeable adaptive variants; the engine picks one per learner.

governance.description: Provenance/authority. Owner: Governance / Quality. Makes the atom auditable and reconstructable.

regulatory_binding.description: Whether the meaning is regulatory-bound (drives controlled translation + review lane).
